_: 3D models that scripts/art/bake3d.mjs turns into sprites. model: where the file is (art-source/ is git-ignored); url: where it is downloaded from the first time; licence and source: where it came from. height in units (a tile is 1 x 1, a human about 1.4), or scale (units per model unit); yaw in degrees; origin 'model' keeps the model's own middle on the tile. palette: the kit's ramps a pixel may take (default rock, moss, grass, wood, iron; 'all' adds the later ones); tone: tones darker (-) or paler (+); detail: how much the model's own colour moves a tone (default 0.5, 0 for none).
